title: Masalaydar Jheenga (Spicy Shrimp)

source.text: S. Abbas Raza, Pakistani & North Indian Cooking (2015)

description: Sweet, hot, and sour, with a thick rather than soupy sauce. The author's preferred pairing is Simple Pulao.

steps.action: Heat in a large pot over high, 2 min:
Add and fry 5 min, stirring often:
items: 2 medium onions (1 lb / 450 g total), finely chopped

steps.action: Add and fry 2 min, stirring often:
Add and fry 3 min, stirring often:
items: 3 medium tomatoes, chopped (or 14 oz / 400 g can)

steps.action: Reduce to medium-low (3/10); stir, cover, and cook 10 min undisturbed.
Mix in; raise to medium (5/10) and return to a boil, stirring occasionally:
items: 1 Tbsp tamarind paste dissolved in ½ cup warm water (120 ml)

steps.action: Add and cook, stirring often, exactly 4 min (6 min for jumbo); turn off heat and move the pot to a cool burner:
items: 1¾ lb fresh shrimp (800 g), peeled and deveined; not frozen
